title: Towards Breaking the Learning System Wall Using Multimodal Tutoring Transcriptions
abstract: arXiv:2609.36502v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Past research using log data has faced the "learning system wall," whereby few methods exist for generalizing models of student learning across platforms. Increasingly, online learning is captured by richer forms of data, including dialog and video, with new affordances. An example of this is remote tutoring programs, where human tutors support students who use learning systems while video conferencing. Toward better platform-general modeling of learning, we introduce an AI-driven multimodal transcription system that processes screen-recording videos into unified screenplay-style transcripts containing audio dialogue and annotated learning log actions. We describe a planned method for temporally aligning AI-generated multimodal transcripts with MATHia learning logs and for identifying and classifying student learning processes to align with MATHia logs. translated_title: 利用多模态辅导转录打破学习系统壁垒
translated_abstract: 以往使用日志数据的研究面临着“学习系统壁垒”，即缺乏能够在不同平台之间推广学生学习模型的方法。如今，在线学习越来越多地以更丰富的数据形式被记录下来，包括对话和视频，这些数据带来了新的可能性。远程辅导项目就是一个例子，其中人类辅导员通过视频会议为使用学习系统的学生提供支持。为了更好地实现跨平台的学习建模，我们引入了一个AI驱动的多模态转录系统，该系统将屏幕录制视频处理成统一的剧本式转录文本，其中包含音频对话和带有标注的学习日志动作。我们描述了一种将AI生成的多模态转录与MATHia学习日志进行时间对齐的规划方法，以及识别和分类学生学习过程以与MATHia日志对齐的方法。最后，我们强调了在捕捉学习过程方面所面临的挑战和潜在的解决方案。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个AI驱动的多模态转录系统，将屏幕录制视频转化为包含音频对话和标注学习日志动作的统一剧本式转录文本，并与MATHia学习日志进行时间对齐，从而打破学习系统壁垒，实现跨平台的学生学习过程建模。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an AI-driven multimodal transcription system that converts screen-recording videos into unified screenplay-style transcripts containing audio dialogue and annotated learning log actions, temporally aligned with MATHia learning logs, to break the "learning system wall" and enable platform-general modeling of student learning processes.
